title: Understanding the Table
text: The table represents several iterations of batch gradient descent. Each row corresponds to a time step $$t$$, and the columns represent different values at that step.

title: Gradient Descent Formula
text: The update rule for gradient descent is given by: $$\operatorname{\theta}\left(t+1\right)$$ $$=$$ θ(t) - \alpha * $$\frac{dL}{dtheta} \operatorname{\theta}\left(t\right)$$. Here, \alpha is the learning rate.

title: Using the Learning Rate
text: The learning rate \alpha is given as $$1$$. This simplifies the update rule to: $$\operatorname{\theta}\left(t+1\right)$$ $$=$$ θ(t) - $$\frac{dL}{dtheta} \operatorname{\theta}\left(t\right)$$.

title: Calculate $$\operatorname{\theta}\left(t+1\right)$$ for $$t=0$$
text: Given θ(t) $$=$$ $$10$$ and $$\frac{dL}{dtheta} \operatorname{\theta}\left(t\right)$$ $$=$$ (b), use the update rule to find $$\operatorname{\theta}\left(t+1\right)$$.
